blocks.tamil_translation: in return for it Allah Ta'ala will help him and make him strong, 2. Whoever opens the door of giving and charity in order to preserve the ties of kinship, Allah Ta'ala will give him more in return for it, 3 Whoever opens the door of begging in order to increase his wealth, Allah Ta'ala will bring about even more decrease in his wealth,” he said.

blocks.narrator: Hazrat Abdullah ibn Amr ibn al-As (RA)
blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَاصِ ﵄ اَنَّ رَسُوْلَ اللهِ ﷺ قَالَ: مِنَ الْكَبَائِرِ شَتْمُ الرَّجُلِ وَالِدَيْهِ، قَالُوْا: يَا رَسُوْلَ اللهِ! وَهَلْ يَشْتِمُ الرَّجُلُ وَالِدَيْهِ؟ قاَلَ: نَعَمْ، يَسُبُّ اَبَا الرَّجُلِ، فَيَسُبُّ اَبَاهُ، وَيَسُبُّ اُمَّهُ، فَيَسُبُّ اُمَّهُ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه مسلم، باب الكبائر واكبرها، رقم: ٢٦٣
blocks.tamil_translation: When Rasulullah ﷺ said, “A man's abusing his own parents is among the major sins,” the Sahabah (RA) asked, “Ya Rasulallah, would a man abuse even his own parents?””Yes. Whoever's father this man abuses, that person in return abuses this man's father. Whoever's mother this man abuses, that person in return abuses this man's mother” (in this way, by abusing the mother and father of others, he becomes the cause of his own mother and father being abused),” the Prophet ﷺ said. Hazrat Abdullah ibn Amr ibn al-As (RA) narrates this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ اَبِيْ هُرَيْرَة ﵁ اَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ: اَللّهُمَّ! اِنِّيْ اَتَّخِذُ عِنْدَكَ عَهْدًا لَنْ تُخْلِفَنِيْهِ، فَإِنَّمَا اَنَا بَشَرٌ، فَأَيُّ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ آذَيْتُهُ، شَتَمْتُهُ، لَعَنْتُهُ، جَلَدْتُهُ، فَاجْعَلْهَا لَهُ صَلَاةً وَزَكَاةً وَقُرْبَةً، تُقَرِّبُهُ بِهَا اِلَيْكَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه مسلم، باب من لعنه النبي ﷺ ....رقم:٦٦١٩
